# Mock LLM End-to-End Test Fixture

This file is a deliberate, tiny, throwaway test fixture used to verify
that umactually can post a real review comment to a real PR using BOTH
provider paths:

1. `--provider openai-compatible` against the OpenAI-format mock
2. `--provider anthropic` against the Anthropic-format mock

It exists so the review has a real, reviewable diff. The file is
expected to be deleted once the test passes and the PR is closed.
